recs.stt: An asteroid wiped out dinosaurs – did it help birds flourish?
recs.x:
luenced by the simple ability to acquire food, but also other adaptations such as the immune system and ability to fight off fungal infections. Flying birds in particular had an advantage because they could forage for seeds over a vast distance while other terrestrial species run out of food (the article's cited study may broadly agree with this as an advantage, but suggests not as much post-chixculub diversification as believed before, and shows pre-chixculub modern bird form examples)

There is a good YouTube documentary on the matter, but it is long: [link]
